test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Process**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Process**' is a noun that refers to a series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end result. (किसी विशेष अंतिम परिणाम को प्राप्त करने के लिए उठाए गए कार्यों या कदमों की एक श्रृंखला)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits grammatically in the sentence.
 
 
• **For example**: *The process of baking a cake involves mixing ingredients, pouring the batter into a pan, and baking it in the oven.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete passage**: *Astronomers have discovered 62 new moons orbiting the ringed planet Saturn. Though some of the moons had been (1) **spotted __**as early as 2019, it takes more than sighting an object close to a planet to (2) **__confirm__*** *it is a moon and not an asteroid making a brief close passage to that planet.*

*Performing a painstaking (3) **__process__ **of matching objects detected on different nights over the course of 24 months, the team tracked 63 objects that they ended up confirming as moons. One of (4) ________ satellites was revealed back in 2021, with the remaining 62 moons gradually announced over the past few weeks.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Progress **refers to the forward or onward movement towards a destination or goal. (किसी गंतव्य या लक्ष्य की ओर आगे या आगे बढ़ना)
 
• **Practice **refers to the repeated performance of an activity in order to improve or master it. (किसी गतिविधि को सुधारने या उसमें महारत हासिल करने के लिए उसका बार-बार किया जाने वाला प्रदर्शन)
 
• **Product **refers to something that is made or produced as a result of a process or activity. (कोई चीज़ जो किसी प्रक्रिया या गतिविधि के परिणामस्वरूप बनाई या उत्पादित की जाती है)
